text: Purchasing my Fastones is definitely one of the best artistic decisions I have ever made! They have completely changed the live painting game for me.. as well as just portrait painting in general. They have given me an entire new level of confidence and pride in my art! They have also cut down time tremendously where I can start focusing on other parts of the painting that I usually have to hurriedly paint because I am focused on the portraits. The quality is AMAZING. So carefully crafted. Heather, who is the mastermind behind Fastones, is an unreal artist herself. She has hand made each tube herself... So you know that they are the best of the best because she uses them herself and is a fellow artist that cares!! I love this product so much I went ahead and got 2. I will never attend a wedding or event where I am painting at without them!! 1000/10 recommend to ALL artists out there 👏👏🎨
title: Absolute LIFE CHANGER.
